A16.title: Independent NuGet/Crate Releases and Provenance Records
A16.boundary_and_ownership: Immutable coordinated package release with independently identified native Engine assets.
A16.native_reuse: NuGet archive/restore rules plus native dependency inventory, optional SBOM/signing tools outside product.
A16.csharp_surface: NuGet managed facade/native RID assets and optional maintainer crate; no user Rust build hooks.
implementation_steps: Package exact validated artifacts and license/NOTICE/source manifest; bind external package digest without circular self-hashing.
Run pristine no-Rust independent consumer: restore/build/run, offline-after-restore edit and explicit-RID AOT publish/execute.
Add an Entity/DTO/Handler and verify native hash unchanged; missing feature produces clear diagnostic instead of rebuilding Rust.
Verify provenance identity/subject digest and compatibility matrix before immutable publication; retain rollback package set.

Build D10 exact owned-package closure: normalized package ID/version entries, explicit dependency edges using exact [V] NuGet ranges, Engine/RID/ABI/capability and native payload hashes. Unrelated ecosystem dependencies retain their separately reviewed policy.

Provide build-transitive validation after restore and before build/publish that compares resolved owned packages and selected native metadata to the accepted closure, emitting a hard mismatch error even if application direct overrides or suppressed NU1608/NU1605 warnings would otherwise restore. A13 integrates shared targets; A02 supplies independent runtime bootstrap compatibility checks.

Verify the complete closure from isolated staging on the declared Windows/Linux profiles, upload immutable dependency leaves before facades, journal each package outcome, then read back and restore every required destination package before exposing the catalog. Partial publication has no atomic rollback.

On 409 or retry/skip-duplicate, read the existing package and verify allowed signing identities, accepted payload entries/nuspec/dependencies/native hashes before resumption. Record upload and downloaded archive hashes separately; legitimate repository-signature envelope change is checked by a package-signature verifier, never by ignoring arbitrary differing entries. A payload or identity conflict stops this release and requires a new version.

Unlist/deprecate is visibility guidance: known-version restores and caches remain. Preserve a previously tested complete closure for deployment rollback; do not hot-unload or replace a native module in an existing process.
